rule_set.name: Dip in a leader
rule_set.about: A leader (the trend template) that fell 7%+ in a week, on 60%+ delivery
rule_set.history: +1.0% a trade over 1 week, +3.5% over 4 weeks, +8.1% over 3 months (2022-26)

rule_set.name: Strong stock, heavy delivery
rule_set.about: A top-10% stock for 6-month strength that fell 3%+ in a week, on 75%+ delivery
rule_set.history: +10.9% a trade over 3 months, positive in all four periods (2022-26)

rule_set.name: Leader after a breakaway gap
rule_set.about: A leader that gapped up on heavy volume in the last 3 months, then fell 5%+ in a week on 45%+ delivery
rule_set.history: +3.7% a trade over 4 weeks, positive in all four periods (2022-26)

rule_set.name: Strong stock below its lower band
rule_set.about: A top-10% stock for 6-month strength that closed below its lower Bollinger band, on 60%+ delivery
rule_set.history: +6.2% a trade over 4 weeks, positive in every year of 2022-26
